subject.title: Session modelOverride persists across gateway restarts, silently overrides config default

question: Should explicit or legacy session model pins continue to survive `/new`, `/reset`, and gateway restart, or should OpenClaw add an opt-in or bulk reset/reconcile path that clears them when config defaults change?
rationale: The remaining behavior affects persisted user state, provider routing, auth-profile selection, and upgrade compatibility, so source inspection cannot decide the intended product contract safely.

options.title: Add explicit reset/reconcile surface
options.body: Preserve explicit pins by default, but add dry-run reporting plus scoped opt-in reset commands for users who want sessions to follow new defaults.

options.title: Change reset precedence
options.body: Make reset or restart automatically discard explicit or legacy pins, accepting a compatibility break for users who use durable session model selections.

options.title: Defer to existing tools
options.body: Keep `/model default`, status visibility, doctor auto cleanup, and #87957/#28965 as the long-term path without adding new behavior for this report.

recommendation.title: Add explicit reset/reconcile surface
recommendation.body: Preserve explicit pins by default, but add dry-run reporting plus scoped opt-in reset commands for users who want sessions to follow new defaults.
